title: Mirror Image Family Tree
description: As a genealogist, you have digitized a family tree represented as a binary tree. To analyze symmetry across family branches, you need to write a function that takes the root of a binary tree and inverts it, so that the left and right children of every node are swapped. Return the root of the inverted tree.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 100].
input_format: The root node of a binary tree.
output_format: The root node of the inverted binary tree.

examples.explanation: Every left and right child pair has been swapped recursively.
Nodes 1 and 3 are swapped under root 2.
